Problem: Sort Array in Even-Odd Pattern
You are given an array of N integers.
Rearrange the array such that:
All even numbers appear first in ascending order
All odd numbers appear after them in descending order
The relative grouping must follow:
Even (Ascending) → Odd (Descending)
📥 Input Format
N
a1 a2 a3 ... aN
📤 Output Format
Print the modified array.
📌 Example
Input
6
5 2 8 1 4 3
Step 1: Separate
Even → 2 8 4
Odd → 5 1 3
Step 2: Sort
Even ascending → 2 4 8
Odd descending → 5 3 1
Final Output
2 4 8 5 3 1
